description: This file defines an admin dashboard page component for managing users, including functionalities such as listing users, searching, filtering by role, creating, bulk uploading, editing, and revoking user accounts. It primarily handles UI rendering and user interactions, with API calls to fetch and manipulate user data.

methods.name: handleRevoke
methods.description: Handles the logic for revoking a user account, including validation of the reason, API call to revoke, and updating the UI.
